laws.rule: Komodo National Park entry tickets and permits (including research, commercial photography and filming) are booked and paid cashless through the park's SiOra app; the park asks visitors to book by the day before the visit at the latest.
laws.heading: Balai Taman Nasional Komodo, Kementerian Kehutanan

sources.supports: SiOra, cashless, book by H-1 (read directly)

layers.authority: Kementerian Kehutanan (Ministry of Forestry) through Balai Taman Nasional Komodo
layers.process: From 1 April 2026 Komodo National Park (Padar, Rinca and Komodo islands, plus 23 dive sites around them) has a visitor quota of 1,000 people a day, about 365,000 a year, set by the Ministry of Forestry. On 24 April 2026 the Deputy Minister said the number is not fixed and may rise after works on Padar. The ministry pages read do not state the current entry fee; ask the park office.
